comments.text:
The main thing you're calling out here - Google's vertical integration - is also why Tesla/xAI is low-key in second place in the AI wars, despite Grok's current issues. Ahead of OpenAI, ahead of Anthropic.

Tesla/xAI is easily the second most vertically integrated. They have data centers just as large, if not larger, than Google. While still making heavy use of Nvidia chips for pre-training, they also have their own GPU/TPU equivalents for inference in Tesla's AI4 and AI5 chips and xAI's forthcoming custom chips - both of which have the added advantage of being built domestically at new TSMC and Samsung fabs in AZ and TX. Their lab is iterating faster than anyone, making up for lost time as a late entrant. And their apps are either swiftly catching up, like Grok's recent Imagine engines for image and video creation, or in leagues entirely of their own with Tesla's self-driving and Optimus bot models.
